jobs.title: Manager, Training and Enablement
jobs.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: As Manager, Training & Enablement , you will lead the team that empowers Cloudbeds colleagues and customers through product and hotel operations training. You will own the knowledge, content and learning programs, run an efficient AI-assisted operating model with expert human oversight, and act as the main liaison between Training & Enablement and our cross-functional partners. Reporting to the SVP of Customer Success, this is a hands-on leadership role with room to shape functional strategy and grow your impact as the team scales. Our Training & Enablement Team: We are a fully remote, multilingual group of trainers, writers, localization specialists and hospitality veterans who turn a fast-moving product into knowledge people can use. We build with a test-and-learn mindset and use AI to strip out drafting and lookup work, so people can focus on teaching, judgment and quality. Our principle: standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
